A is 40% more efficient than B and C is 20% less efficient than B. Working together, they can finish a task in 15 days. In how many days, will B alone complete 75% of the task?
questions.solution:
Let the efficiency of B be 100.

Efficiency of A will be = 100 × [140/100] = 140

Efficiency of C will be = 100 × [80/100] = 80

Efficiency ratio of A, B and C = 140 ∶ 100 ∶ 80 = 7 ∶ 5 ∶ 4

Total work = (7 + 5 + 4) × 15 = 240

75% of total work = 240 × [75/100] = 180

75% of total work B will complete in = 180/5 = 36 days

questions.question: A train without stoppage travels with an average speed of 65 km/h and with stoppage, it travels with an average speed of 52 km/h. For how many minutes does the train stop on an average per hour?
questions.solution:
Without stoppage average speed = 65 km/h

With stoppages average speed = 52 km/h

As we know,

Time of rest per hour equal to the difference in average speed divided by the speed without stoppage.

Required time = [(65 – 52)/65] × 60 = 12

So, A train stops on an average 12 minute/hr

questions.question: The average marks of 45 students was found to be 66. If the marks of two students were incorrectly entered as 28 and 64 instead of 82 and 46 respectively then what is the correct average?
questions.solution:
Average marks of 45 students = 66

Sum of marks of 45 students = 66 × 45 = 2970

According to the question

Correct sum of marks of 45 students = 2970 – 28 – 64 + 82 + 46 = 3006

Correct average marks of 45 students = 3006/45 = 66.8

**Short trick****∶ **

⇒ 66 + [(82 + 46 – 28 – 64)/45]

⇒ 66 + [36/45]

⇒ 66 + 0.8

⇒ 66.8

Radii of two circular faces of the frustum of a cone are 3 cm and 2 cm.

Height of the circular frustum of cone H = 21 cm

As we know,

Volume of the frustum of cone = 1/3 × π [R² + r² + Rr] H

⇒ 1/3 × 22/7 × [3² + 2² + 3 × 2] × 21

⇒ 22 × [9 + 4 + 6]

⇒ 22 × 19

⇒ 418

questions.question: The price of sugar is increased by 22%. A person wants to increase his expenditure by 12% only. By what percent should he decrease his consumption, nearest to one decimal place?
questions.solution:
Let the initial price of sugar be 100x.

Price of sugar after increased = 100x × [122/100] = 122x

Person wants his expenditure increase by 12% only, so his expenditure should be = 100x × [112/100] = 112x

Required percentage = [(122 – 112x)/122] × 100 = 8.19% ≈ 8.2%

questions.question: What is the least value of x such that 517x324 is divisible by 12?
questions.solution:
Number 517x324 is divisible by 12, so we can say number also divisible by both 4 and 3

**Divisibility law of 4****∶ **A number divisible by 4 if its last two digit is divisible by 4

**Divisibility law of 3****∶ **A number is divisible by 3 if sum of its digit is divisible by 3.

⇒ 517x324 is divisible by 3 if x = 2

Or

⇒ 5 + 1 + 7 + x + 3 + 2 + 4

⇒ 22 + x

Put x = 2

⇒ 22 + 2

⇒ 24 (which is divisible by 3)

questions.question: In ΔABC, AD is a median and P is a point on AD such that AP ∶ PD is 3 ∶ 4,then ar (ΔAPB) ∶ ar(ΔABC) is equal to∶

ar ΔADB = ar ΔADC

questions.question: Two articles are sold for Rs. 10,005 each. On one, the seller gains 15% and on the other, he loses 13%. What is his overall gain or loss percent. Correct to two decimal places?
questions.solution:
SP of each article = Rs. 10,005

CP of first article = 10,005 × [100/115] = 87,00

CP of second article = 10,005 × [100/87] = 11,500

Total SP of both article = 10,005 × 2 = 20,010

Total CP of both article = 8,700 + 11,500 = 20,200

Total loss = 20,200 – 20,010 = 190

Loss percentage = [190/20,200] × 100 = 0.94%

questions.question: Chords AB and CD of a circle, when produced, meet at a point P outside the circle, If AB = 6 cm, CD = 3 cm and PD = 5 cm, then PB is equal to∶
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d23a4f76aaaedaf1e0f4b30b7a847a083984aa24398087463803b6433346315c.png] 

Given, AB = 6 cm, CD = 3 cm, PD = 5 cm

Let the length of PB be x, PA = (x + 6) and PC = 5 + 3 = 8 cm

As we know,

PB × PA = PD × PC

⇒ x × (x + 6) = 5 × 8

⇒ x² + 6x – 40 = 0

⇒ x² + 10x – 4x – 40 = 0

⇒ x (x + 10) – 4 (x + 10) = 0

⇒ (x + 10) (x – 4) = 0

⇒ (x + 10) = 0

⇒ x = -10 [not possible]

⇒ (x – 4) = 0

⇒ x = 4
